units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> (expl. <he>איש האדמה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 9:20">Gen. IX, 20</cite>) <he>שבשבילו נִתְלַחְלְחָה האדמה</he> since for his sake the ground became moist again (cmp.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Gen. R. s. 33</cite>, end, quot. s. v. <cite ref="C01325"><he>גְּרִיד</he></cite>). Y. Sabb. IV, 6ᵈ bot. <he>יבישין שנִתְלַחְלְחוּ</he> dry (plants) which have been moistened again, opp. <he>לחין מחמת עצמן</he>, v. <cite ref="L00333"><he>לַח</he></cite>.
